title: Bringing the People Back In: Contesting Benchmark Machine Learning Datasets
findings: The paper does not analyze religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it. The work focuses on outlining a research program to investigate the histories, values, and labor embedded in machine learning datasets, with a focus on biases related to race, gender, sexual orientation, class, and disability.
